entities.summary: Brandon Roger Snyder is an American former professional baseball utility player and current coach. Since August 2021, he has been the bullpen catcher for the Washington Nationals of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played in MLB for the Baltimore Orioles, Texas Rangers, Boston Red Sox, Atlanta Braves, and Tampa Bay Rays.
